details.s: Elu Thingol, originally Elwë, was an Elf of the Teleri during the First Age. His brother was Olwë, who became the Lord of Alqualondë, Lord of Tol Eressëa, and King of the Teleri of Aman; they may have also had a second brother called Elmo, whom was a good friend of Finwë, the first King of the Ñoldor during the times before the Elves reached Aman.
f: King of the Teleri, King of Doriath, Lord of Beleriand
Teleri, Sindar of Doriath (House of Thingol)
FA 503 (aged ±4566), Menegroth, killed by the Dwarves
